WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
INVESTIGATION CONDUCTED UNDER SECTION 2 OF THE CHAPTER No. 04 OF 1991 RELATINGTO POWERS OF SUPERVISION OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENTINSTIUTIONS

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the Section 2 of the Charter No. 04 of 1991 relating to powers of supervision ofadministration of the Local Government Institutions I, Isura Devapriya, the Chief Minister of Western Provincial Councilsand the Minister of Finance and Planning, Engineering Services, Law and Order, Local Government and ProvincialAdministration, Economic Promotion, Power and Energy, Environment Affairs, Water Supply and Drainage and TourismAffairs, do hereby appoint Mr. Kumara Hewage Sumithrapala, Retired Judge of the High Court, as an Investigation Committeeof one member, to investigate and submit a report within three months as to whether the offences specified under Section2(1) of the above Charter have been committed by W. Samanlal Fernando whilst holding office as the Mayor of MoratuwaMunicipal Council.
Matters/Charges which are to be investigated.

1.You have committed, whilst holding office as the Mayor of the Municipal Council Moratuwa, the offencesmentioned in Section/s 2(i)(a) and/or 2(i)(c) of the Charter No. 04 of 1991 by way of granting approval to felland remove the teak wood trees in the cemetery of Rawatawatta under the administration of Municipal CouncilMoratuwa during the period from 14.11.2015 to 07.12.2015 or a close period, without obtaining proper approvalfrom the Municipal Council.

2.You have committed, whilst holding office as the Mayor of the Municipal Council Moratuwa, the offencesmentioned in Section/s 2(i)(a) and/or 2(i)(c) of the Charter No. 04 of 1991 by way of taking action to enter intoan agreement with W. E. Security Services Pvt. Ltd., at No. 26/1/1, Church Road, Rathnapura to maintain securityservices within the premises of the Municipal Council Moratuwa without obtaining proper approval from theMunicipal Council and/or getting approval of the Council for the agreement.

3.You have committed, whilst holding office as the Mayor of the Municipal Council Moratuwa, the offencesmentioned in Section/s 2(i)(a) and/or 2(i)(c) of the Charter No. 04 of 1991 by not implementing the CourtOrder issued to remove the unathorized construction at No. 163A, Station Road, Moratuwa and/or making anenvironment not to implement the said order during the period from 10.07.2009 to 30.08.2010 or a closeperiod.

Further, in terms of the provisions mentioned in Section 2(2) of the Charter No. 04 of 1991 relating to powers ofsupervision of administration of the Local Government Institutions, the powers vested in the Commissioner appointed bythe Investigations Commission Act are vested in this one member investigation committee. It is further informed that thewritten and oral evidence identified to be made applicable in the investigation on the above matter have been included in thefollowing Schedule.

ISURA DEVAPRIYA,Chief Minister of Western Province Provincial Counciland the Minister of Finance and Planning, Engineering Services,Law and Order, Local Government and Provincial Administration,Economic Promotion, Power and Energy, Environment Affairs,Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism Affairs.
Office of the Chief Minister of Western Province,Shrawasthi Mandiraya,Colombo 07,16th March 2016.
